final_message: PJR-XTAN: adopted option B. Unified the review task-completion vocabulary: `verdict_definitions` and the schema enum now use the same 6 values as the review `verdict`, with a single source in `src/review-types.ts` (`REVIEW_VERDICTS`). `revise` maps to `incomplete`. The grade rubric `review_verdict` mapping is retargeted to complete / complete-with-findings / incomplete; the grade vocabulary, rubric id and scoring are unchanged. Added the review input rule section to `review-guide.md`. Legacy values now fail with errors that name the replacement, in both the viewpoints loader and the reporter. Also rewrote the overview of the not-yet-created `br-review-verdict` catalog entry, updated the ticket's work and result sections, and added or adjusted unit tests. The new tests have not been run yet; typecheck, unit, integration and schema validation are left to the parent runner.
